current_order_visibility_note: The current ordering remains visible on compact/mobile layouts even when the control collapses into a select menu.
default_order_note: Each covered route states its ordinary default ordering model so the first visible item is not mistaken for a substantive official priority claim.
delivery_role_note: Bounded sort-order surface for official voter-information routes where non-table answer-bearing items can be reordered by default or by an explicit sort control.
featured_or_promoted_lane_note: Any separately featured or promoted items are labeled as such and are not presented as if they were simply the top of the ordinary sort.
help_or_overview_escape_note: If ordering alone does not resolve the case, the route preserves a visible path to the broader overview or authoritative office/help lane.
order_change_status_note: Dynamic order changes are announced as status updates without moving focus away from the control the voter is using.
order_control_note: Where a sort control exists, it is labeled clearly, exposes the current value, and changes order only on explicit user commit.
order_model_boundary_note: This surface covers non-table list/card ordering only; table sorting and grid header semantics are reviewed under docs/446-*.

ordered_result_routes.featured_or_promoted_lane_note: A separately labeled 'Recommended for your address' block is visually distinct from the ordinary sorted list and links to the official lookup explanation.
ordered_result_routes.order_change_note: Changing the sort reorders the same location set and exposes a polite status message such as '23 locations reordered by nearest'.
ordered_result_routes.reset_to_default_note: The control includes an explicit return to the default alphabetical order rather than trapping the user in the last experimental ordering.

refindability_after_reorder_note: The route preserves enough continuity that a voter can tell the same official set is being shown in a different order and can re-find the controlling item after a resort.
sort_order_surface_label: Example sort-order posture for an official voter-information route
